intent.raw_query: Vietnam on $800, backpacking 10 days, street food and culture, April 2026

experiences.name: Hanoi Old Quarter Street Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore the labyrinthine streets of Hanoi's Old Quarter on foot, sampling iconic Vietnamese dishes like Bun Cha, Banh Mi, Pho, and Egg Coffee from legendary local vendors and hole-in-the-wall eateries. Join a budget walking food tour or self-guide using a map of top-rated street stalls.

experiences.name: Hoi An Ancient Town Lantern Festival
experiences.description: Wander through the UNESCO-listed Ancient Town of Hoi An on the night of the full moon when the streets are lit entirely by colorful silk lanterns. Release a lantern on the Thu Bon River, browse local craft stalls, and taste White Rose dumplings and Cao Lau noodles unique to this region.

experiences.name: Motorbiking the Hai Van Pass
experiences.description: Rent a motorbike or join a budget group tour to ride the legendary Hai Van Pass between Da Nang and Hue, one of Southeast Asia's most scenic coastal mountain roads. Stop at the old French and American war bunkers at the summit for panoramic views of the South China Sea and lush jungle valleys.
experiences.location: Hai Van Pass, between Da Nang and Hue

experiences.name: Mekong Delta Sampan Boat & Market Tour
experiences.description: Board a traditional wooden sampan boat to navigate the narrow canals of the Mekong Delta, visiting the famous Cai Rang floating market where vendors sell tropical fruits and local produce directly from their boats. Stop at a coconut candy workshop and a riverside family home for a home-cooked Vietnamese lunch.
experiences.location: Cai Rang, Can Tho, Mekong Delta

experiences.name: Ninh Binh Kayaking Through Trang An Grottoes
experiences.description: Paddle a kayak or take a traditional rowboat through the stunning limestone karst caves and emerald waterways of Trang An, a UNESCO World Heritage landscape often called 'Halong Bay on land.' Explore ancient temples, rice paddies, and hidden grottos at a fraction of the cost of Halong Bay cruises, making it perfect for backpackers.
experiences.location: Trang An Scenic Landscape Complex, Ninh Binh

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Vietnam
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at airport, clear customs and immigration, exchange currency at the airport or nearby ATM for best rates. Take a budget bus or shared shuttle to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and get oriented with the local neighborhood map. Take a slow walk along the beachfront to decompress from travel.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the nearest local street food market on foot. Sample classic Vietnamese street snacks like bánh mì, gỏi cuốn (fresh spring rolls), and chè (sweet dessert soup). Stroll the beach promenade at sunset and enjoy the coastal atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bánh mì sandwich from a street vendor near the resort (~15,000–20,000 VND)
meals.dinner: Local street food stall dinner — try bún bò Huế or phở with iced Vietnamese coffee (~40,000–60,000 VND)

day_by_day.notes: Exchange at least 500,000–1,000,000 VND on arrival for initial expenses. Avoid airport taxi touts; use metered taxis or ride-hailing apps like Grab for fair pricing.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early and head to the nearest local market (chợ) to experience authentic Vietnamese morning culture. Watch vendors sell fresh produce, seafood, and street breakfast dishes. Try a bowl of bánh canh or xôi (sticky rice) from market stalls.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby cultural or historical landmark such as a local pagoda or communal house (đình làng). Explore the surrounding neighborhood on foot or rent a bicycle (~50,000–80,000 VND/day) to cover more ground. Stop at a local café for cà phê trứng (egg coffee) or cà phê sữa đá (iced milk coffee).
day_by_day.evening: Join a free or low-cost walking tour of the local area if available, or self-guide through the old quarter streets. Find a rooftop or beachside spot to watch the sunset. Dinner at a local cơm bình dân (budget rice restaurant).

meals.breakfast: Xôi or bánh cuốn from the morning market (~20,000–30,000 VND)
meals.lunch: Bún thịt nướng (grilled pork rice noodles) from a street stall (~35,000–50,000 VND)
meals.dinner: Cơm bình dân set meal with rice, meat, and vegetables (~40,000–60,000 VND)

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting pagodas — cover shoulders and knees. Bargain respectfully at markets but avoid haggling at small family food stalls.

day_by_day.morning: Take a budget local bus or Grab ride to explore a nearby fishing village or coastal community. Watch fishermen bring in the morning catch and interact with locals. Photography opportunities are excellent in the early morning light.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the beach — swim, relax, or try affordable water activities like kayaking (~100,000–150,000 VND/hour). Explore beachside shacks selling fresh coconuts and local snacks. Visit a small local museum or cultural center if available nearby.
day_by_day.evening: Head to a night market or street food alley for dinner. Try grilled seafood skewers, nem nướng (grilled pork rolls), and fresh fruit shakes. Socialize with fellow backpackers at a budget hostel common area or beach bar.

meals.breakfast: Phở bò (beef noodle soup) from a street vendor (~30,000–45,000 VND)
meals.lunch: Fresh seafood at a beachside local eatery — grilled fish with rice (~60,000–80,000 VND)
meals.dinner: Night market street food spread — mix of skewers, spring rolls, and fruit (~50,000–70,000 VND)

day_by_day.notes: Always negotiate boat or activity prices before committing. Carry sunscreen, a hat, and a reusable water bottle to stay hydrated on beach days.

day_by_day.morning: Take a day trip by local bus or rented motorbike to a nearby town or cultural site. Visit a traditional craft village (pottery, silk weaving, or lacquerware) to learn about Vietnamese artisan traditions. Many villages offer free entry and cheap demonstrations.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore a local temple complex or UNESCO-listed site if within reach. Walk through the grounds, observe local worshippers, and learn about Vietnamese spiritual practices. Pick up small handmade souvenirs directly from artisans at fair prices.
day_by_day.evening: Return to base by early evening. Cook or share a meal at a local cooking class if budget allows (~200,000–300,000 VND), or find a family-run restaurant for an authentic home-style dinner. Reflect on the day with a walk along the beach.

meals.breakfast: Bánh mì ốp la (bánh mì with fried egg) from a street cart (~20,000–25,000 VND)
meals.lunch: Local restaurant near the craft village — bún chả or cơm tấm (~40,000–55,000 VND)
meals.dinner: Family-run restaurant dinner — canh chua (sour soup) and stir-fried vegetables with rice (~50,000–70,000 VND)

day_by_day.notes: Renting a motorbike costs around 100,000–150,000 VND/day — always wear a helmet and carry your passport or a copy. Check road conditions before heading out.

day_by_day.morning: Visit a local Buddhist pagoda or Hindu Cham tower (depending on region) for a peaceful morning of cultural exploration. Arrive early before crowds. Participate in morning prayers if welcomed by monks or caretakers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore a local street art district or murals if available, or visit a vibrant local market for afternoon shopping. Browse handmade goods, local spices, dried fruits, and unique Vietnamese snacks. Practice your bargaining skills respectfully.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a free or low-cost cultural performance such as traditional music (đàn bầu or đàn tranh), water puppetry, or a local festival if one is happening. Enjoy dinner at a bustling street food corner.

meals.breakfast: Cháo (Vietnamese rice porridge) with ginger and pork (~25,000–35,000 VND)
meals.lunch: Mì Quảng (turmeric noodles) or hủ tiếu at a local eatery (~35,000–50,000 VND)
meals.dinner: Street food corner feast — bánh xèo (sizzling crepes) with fresh herbs and dipping sauce (~40,000–60,000 VND)

day_by_day.notes: Water puppet shows typically cost 60,000–100,000 VND and are well worth the budget splurge for cultural immersion. Book in advance if possible.

day_by_day.morning: Rent a bicycle and explore the countryside or coastal roads at your own pace. Ride through rice paddies, small villages, and scenic viewpoints. Stop at roadside stalls for fresh sugarcane juice (~10,000–15,000 VND).
day_by_day.afternoon: Find a hidden beach cove or natural swimming spot recommended by locals or hostel staff. Spend the afternoon swimming and relaxing away from tourist crowds. Pack a simple picnic from the morning market.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort area and treat yourself to a budget foot massage (~80,000–120,000 VND for 30–60 minutes) after a day of cycling. Have a casual dinner at a local seafood shack on the beach.

meals.breakfast: Bánh ướt (steamed rice rolls) with shrimp and herbs (~25,000–35,000 VND)
meals.lunch: Picnic lunch from the market — fresh fruit, bánh mì, and local snacks (~30,000–40,000 VND)
meals.dinner: Beachside seafood shack — grilled squid or prawns with rice (~70,000–100,000 VND)

day_by_day.notes: Always inform someone at your accommodation of your cycling route. Carry a basic first aid kit and a fully charged phone with offline maps downloaded.

day_by_day.morning: Join a free walking food tour or self-organize a street food crawl through the local neighborhood. Sample at least 5–6 different dishes across multiple vendors. Focus on regional specialties unique to the area.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local history museum or war memorial to gain deeper insight into Vietnamese history and culture. Most municipal museums charge minimal entry fees (10,000–30,000 VND). Spend time reading exhibits and understanding the local narrative.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the local nightlife scene on a budget — find a backpacker-friendly bar with happy hour deals or bia hơi (fresh draft beer) corners where a glass costs as little as 5,000–10,000 VND. Meet fellow travelers and share stories.

meals.breakfast: Street food crawl breakfast — try chè, xôi, and bánh tiêu (hollow donuts) (~30,000–40,000 VND total)
meals.lunch: Bún bò Huế (spicy beef noodle soup) at a local specialist stall (~40,000–55,000 VND)
meals.dinner: Bia hơi corner — snack on đậu phụ chiên (fried tofu), lạc rang (roasted peanuts), and nem rán with cold draft beer (~50,000–80,000 VND)

day_by_day.notes: Bia hơi culture is a quintessential Vietnamese experience — sit on tiny plastic stools, order by the glass, and enjoy the social atmosphere. Drink responsibly and stay aware of your surroundings at night.

day_by_day.morning: Take an early morning boat trip or kayak excursion on a nearby river, lagoon, or bay. Observe local fishermen at work and enjoy the tranquil waterway scenery. Budget boat tours can be found for 100,000–200,000 VND.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local eco-park, mangrove forest, or nature reserve for a budget-friendly nature experience. Many areas have free or low-cost entry. Bring insect repellent and comfortable walking shoes.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a free outdoor event, community gathering, or temple festival if one is scheduled. Otherwise, explore a new neighborhood for dinner and find a restaurant you haven't tried yet. Try lẩu (Vietnamese hot pot) shared with new friends.

meals.breakfast: Phở gà (chicken noodle soup) from an early-morning vendor (~30,000–45,000 VND)
meals.lunch: Cơm hến (baby clam rice) or bánh căn (mini rice cakes) at a local eatery (~35,000–50,000 VND)
meals.dinner: Budget lẩu (hot pot) for two at a local restaurant — split costs (~80,000–120,000 VND per person)

day_by_day.notes: Negotiate boat prices in advance and confirm what is included. Group tours are always cheaper than private ones — ask at your hostel or resort if they can connect you with other travelers.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to a deeper cultural experience — visit a local school, community center, or volunteer opportunity if arranged in advance. Alternatively, take a free online-guided self-tour of significant architectural landmarks in the area.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to a local market for souvenir shopping — focus on authentic, locally-made items like lacquerware, embroidery, conical hats (nón lá), and Vietnamese coffee. Avoid tourist trap shops and buy directly from producers.
day_by_day.evening: Splurge slightly on a farewell-style dinner at a mid-range local restaurant to celebrate your trip — try a multi-dish spread of Vietnamese classics. End the night with a final beach walk under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Bánh mì thịt (pork bánh mì) with strong Vietnamese drip coffee (~25,000–35,000 VND)
meals.lunch: Nem cuốn (fresh spring rolls) and bún thịt nướng at a casual eatery (~40,000–55,000 VND)
meals.dinner: Slightly elevated local restaurant — gà nướng sả (lemongrass grilled chicken), rau muống xào tỏi (stir-fried morning glory), and steamed rice (~80,000–120,000 VND)

day_by_day.notes: When buying souvenirs, compare prices at 2–3 stalls before purchasing. Genuine Vietnamese coffee beans make excellent lightweight gifts — look for Arabica from Da Lat or Robusta from the Central Highlands.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for one final sunrise at the beach or a nearby viewpoint. Take a last walk through the neighborhood, revisit your favorite street food spot, and say goodbye to vendors and locals you've connected with.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack up, check out of Aegean Bliss Resort, and store luggage if needed. Use remaining local currency on last-minute snacks, drinks, or small gifts. Head to the airport or bus station with plenty of time — use Grab for reliable transport.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Vietnam with a full heart and great memories. If the flight is late evening, spend remaining time at an airport café reviewing photos and notes from the trip.

meals.breakfast: Final street food breakfast — revisit your favorite dish from the trip (~25,000–40,000 VND)
meals.lunch: Airport or transit area meal — look for local food courts inside the terminal (~60,000–100,000 VND)
meals.dinner: Airport restaurant or packed snacks for the flight (~varies)

day_by_day.notes: Arrive at the airport at least 2–3 hours before international departure. Spend remaining VND on snacks or coffee as currency exchange back to home currency often has poor rates. Keep digital copies of all travel documents accessible.

trip_options.title: Classic Vietnam Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival — Flight LH lands at 13:00. No morning activities scheduled. Rest and prepare for afternoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort and settle into your beachfront room. Take a leisurely stroll along the beach to get oriented with the surroundings. Explore the immediate resort area and nearby coastal promenade.
day_by_day.evening: Head into the nearest local town for a gentle first-night wander. Visit a night market or street food alley to sample Vietnamese snacks like bánh mì, chả giò (spring rolls), and fresh sugarcane juice. Get a feel for the local pace of life.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport upon arrival
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at the airport or a casual café near the resort after check-in — try a bowl of phở or bún bò Huế
meals.dinner: Local street food stalls near the resort town — budget around 80,000–150,000 VND per dish

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light. Stay hydrated — April can be warm and humid in Vietnam. Exchange currency at the airport or use an ATM for Vietnamese Dong (VND). Grab a local SIM card at the airport for easy navigation.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early and take a sunrise walk along the beach. Join local fishermen at the shore to watch the morning catch come in — a beautiful cultural moment. Rent a bicycle from the resort or a nearby shop to explore the coastal village.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby traditional Vietnamese fishing village or local market. Browse handmade crafts, fresh produce, and interact with vendors. Stop at a local pagoda or temple for a taste of Vietnamese spiritual culture.
day_by_day.evening: Take a cooking class at a local restaurant or community kitchen — learn to make fresh spring rolls (gỏi cuốn) and a Vietnamese soup. This is a great way to connect with local culture and fellow travelers.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or a local bánh mì stall — try bánh mì trứng (egg bánh mì) for around 20,000–30,000 VND
meals.lunch: Fresh seafood at a beachside local eatery — grilled fish, clams, or shrimp with rice for 100,000–200,000 VND
meals.dinner: Dinner included in the cooking class experience, or dine at a mid-range restaurant serving authentic Vietnamese cuisine

day_by_day.notes: Book the cooking class in advance — many popular ones fill up quickly. Wear comfortable clothes and sunscreen for the bicycle ride.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to a nearby UNESCO World Heritage Site or major cultural landmark (e.g., Hội An Ancient Town, Mỹ Sơn Sanctuary, or Huế Citadel depending on resort location). Depart early by local bus or hired motorbike taxi to make the most of the day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring the heritage site — walk through ancient streets, visit historic temples, and browse artisan workshops. In Hội An, try a tailoring shop for custom-made clothing at affordable prices.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the iconic lantern lighting ceremony (if in Hội An) along the Thu Bồn River. Browse lantern stalls, release a paper lantern on the river, and soak in the magical atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Cháo (Vietnamese rice porridge) or xôi (sticky rice) at a local street stall before departure
meals.lunch: Cao lầu noodles (a Hội An specialty) at a traditional local restaurant — around 50,000–80,000 VND
meals.dinner: White Rose dumplings and grilled pork skewers (thịt nướng) at a riverside restaurant in the Ancient Town

day_by_day.notes: Purchase a combined heritage ticket for Hội An (around 120,000 VND) to access multiple sites. Wear modest clothing when visiting temples and pagodas.

day_by_day.morning: Motorbike or scooter adventure along a scenic coastal or mountain road. Rent a semi-automatic scooter (if experienced) or hire a local xe ôm (motorbike taxi) for a guided ride through rice paddies, villages, and viewpoints.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stop at a local craft village — visit a traditional pottery village (like Thanh Hà near Hội An) or a mat-weaving village. Try your hand at making a pot or weaving a small mat with guidance from local artisans.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort area. Relax with a Vietnamese massage at a local spa (budget spas offer excellent value — around 200,000–350,000 VND for a full-body massage). Stroll the beach at sunset.

meals.breakfast: Mì Quảng (turmeric noodles with pork and shrimp) at a local breakfast spot
meals.lunch: Picnic-style lunch packed from a local market, or stop at a roadside quán (eatery) for com bình dân (everyday rice dishes)
meals.dinner: Seafood barbecue at a beachside restaurant — pick your own fresh catch from the display and have it grilled

day_by_day.notes: Always wear a helmet when riding motorbikes — it is legally required and essential for safety. Check your travel insurance covers motorbike riding.

day_by_day.morning: Visit a local open-air wet market at dawn (most Vietnamese markets are busiest 6–9 AM). Observe the vibrant chaos of vendors selling exotic fruits, live seafood, herbs, and street food. Sample fresh tropical fruits like dragon fruit, rambutan, and mangosteen.
day_by_day.afternoon: Cultural museum visit — explore a regional museum covering Vietnamese history, the Cham civilization, or the Vietnam War depending on your location. Many regional museums charge minimal entry fees (20,000–40,000 VND).
day_by_day.evening: Join a street food walking tour led by a local guide. Visit 4–6 hidden street food spots, tasting dishes like bún thịt nướng, bánh xèo (sizzling crepes), and chè (Vietnamese sweet dessert soup).

meals.breakfast: Bún bò Huế (spicy beef noodle soup) at a market stall — authentic and filling for around 40,000–60,000 VND
meals.lunch: Com tấm (broken rice with grilled pork) at a local com tấm restaurant
meals.dinner: Street food tour covers multiple tastings — budget around 300,000–500,000 VND including tour fee

day_by_day.notes: Carry small bills (5,000–20,000 VND notes) for street food purchases. The street food tour can be booked through the resort concierge or apps like Airbnb Experiences or GetYourGuide.

day_by_day.morning: Beach and water activity morning — try kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, or snorkeling in the clear coastal waters. Many beachfront operators offer rentals at reasonable rates (100,000–200,000 VND per hour).
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a boat trip to a nearby island or bay for swimming and exploration. Pack sunscreen and a waterproof bag. Alternatively, hike to a scenic coastal viewpoint for panoramic photos.
day_by_day.evening: Sundowner drinks at a beachfront bar — try a local bia hơi (fresh draft beer, very affordable at 10,000–15,000 VND per glass) or a Vietnamese iced coffee (cà phê đá). Watch the sunset over the water.

meals.breakfast: Bánh cuốn (steamed rice rolls with pork and mushroom) at a local breakfast stall
meals.lunch: Fresh seafood lunch on the island or boat — grilled squid, steamed clams, and rice
meals.dinner: Lẩu (Vietnamese hot pot) at a local restaurant — great for a social, shareable meal. Budget around 200,000–350,000 VND per person

day_by_day.notes: Apply reef-safe sunscreen to protect coral ecosystems. Book boat trips through reputable local operators recommended by the resort.

day_by_day.morning: Visit a nearby Buddhist pagoda or Cao Đài temple for a morning prayer ceremony. Dress respectfully (covered shoulders and knees). Observe monks or worshippers and learn about Vietnamese religious practices.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore a nearby town or city on a self-guided backpacker walk. Navigate local alleys, visit a bookshop or art gallery, and browse independent boutiques selling Vietnamese lacquerware, silk, and handmade goods.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Vietnamese water puppet show (múa rối nước) if available locally, or watch a live traditional music performance featuring đàn bầu (monochord) or đàn tranh (zither).

meals.breakfast: Phở bò (beef pho) at a classic phở shop — the quintessential Vietnamese breakfast
meals.lunch: Bánh mì from a renowned local bánh mì cart — try with pâté, pickled vegetables, and chili
meals.dinner: Mid-range Vietnamese restaurant featuring regional specialties — try bò lá lốt (grilled beef in betel leaves) and gỏi cuốn

day_by_day.notes: Water puppet shows typically cost 80,000–150,000 VND per ticket. Book in advance for evening performances. Photography is usually allowed but check with the venue.

day_by_day.morning: Half-day excursion to a nearby natural attraction — a waterfall, national park, cave system, or rice terrace depending on your region. Hire a local guide for a more enriching experience and to support the local economy.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort area and spend time relaxing or exploring a local café culture scene. Vietnamese cafés (especially in central Vietnam) are architectural gems — visit a garden café or a rooftop café with views.
day_by_day.evening: Participate in a local community experience — visit a Vietnamese family home for a homestay dinner (can be arranged through local tour operators), or join a communal evening at a bia hơi street corner with locals.

meals.breakfast: Xôi (sticky rice with toppings like mung bean, fried shallots, or pork floss) from a street cart
meals.lunch: Picnic at the natural site or eat at a local trailhead eatery serving simple Vietnamese rice dishes
meals.dinner: Homestay dinner with a Vietnamese family — expect multiple shared dishes including rau muống (morning glory stir-fry), canh chua (sour soup), and steamed fish

day_by_day.notes: Wear sturdy shoes for the nature excursion. Bring insect repellent and a light rain jacket as April weather can be unpredictable. Homestay dinners should be booked 1–2 days in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Free morning for independent exploration — revisit a favorite spot, do some souvenir shopping at a local market, or simply enjoy a slow morning at a Vietnamese café with a cà phê trứng (egg coffee) or cà phê sữa đá (iced milk coffee).
day_by_day.afternoon: Attend a Vietnamese language or calligraphy workshop — short 1–2 hour cultural workshops are widely available in tourist areas and offer a fun, hands-on cultural experience. Learn to write your name in Vietnamese script.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at a well-regarded mid-range Vietnamese restaurant. Splurge slightly on a multi-course meal featuring the best regional dishes you haven't tried yet. Toast to a great trip with a glass of ruou gao (Vietnamese rice wine) or a Tiger beer.

meals.breakfast: Slow café breakfast — cà phê trứng (egg coffee) with bánh mì or a Vietnamese-style omelette
meals.lunch: Bún chả (grilled pork with vermicelli noodles) — a northern Vietnamese classic beloved worldwide
meals.dinner: Celebratory dinner at a top-rated local restaurant — try chả cá Lã Vọng (turmeric fish with dill) or a full seafood spread. Budget 300,000–600,000 VND per person

day_by_day.notes: Use this day to pick up last-minute souvenirs — Vietnamese lacquerware, silk scarves, hand-embroidered items, and artisan coffee make excellent gifts. Bargain politely at markets.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise walk on the beach or a quiet morning yoga session (many resorts offer complimentary morning yoga). Pack your bags and do a final check of the room. Arrange checkout and airport transfer with the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on departure time — visit any last sights, grab a final Vietnamese iced coffee, or relax at the resort pool. If time allows, pick up fresh tropical fruits or local snacks at a nearby market to bring home.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the airport for your departure flight. Reflect on 10 incredible days of street food, culture, and backpacker adventures across Vietnam.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or a final bowl of phở at a local stall — savor every last bite
meals.lunch: Light meal at an airport café or a quick stop at a local restaurant near the airport
meals.dinner: Airport dining or on the flight

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your international flight for check-in, security, and immigration. Keep some VND for last-minute purchases or tips. Consider tipping your guides, drivers, and hotel staff as a gesture of appreciation — it is warmly received in Vietnam.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Vietnam Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at 13:00 - No morning activities scheduled. Rest and prepare for the journey.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private airport transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, settle into your beachfront suite, and enjoy a welcome drink while taking in the coastal views. Take a leisurely stroll along the resort's private beach to acclimate.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the nearest coastal town on a private guided evening walk. Discover local street food vendors and night market stalls for an authentic first taste of Vietnamese culture.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight or airport lounge)
meals.lunch: Not applicable (traveling)
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's signature restaurant featuring fresh Vietnamese seafood — try grilled tiger prawns with lemongrass and bánh mì on the side. Pair with a local Dalat wine.

day_by_day.notes: Arrival day — keep activities light. Confirm resort concierge services for upcoming days. Request a premium room upgrade if available. Hydrate well after the flight.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise yoga session on the beachfront terrace followed by a curated Vietnamese breakfast experience at the resort. Afterward, take a guided cultural walk through a nearby fishing village to observe traditional boat-building and net-weaving crafts.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private cooking class with a renowned local chef — learn to prepare phở bò, fresh spring rolls (gỏi cuốn), and chè (Vietnamese dessert soup). Classes held in a premium villa kitchen setting with market sourcing included.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktail hour at the resort's rooftop bar. Enjoy handcrafted Vietnamese-inspired cocktails such as lychee mojitos and tamarind sours while watching the sun dip over the South China Sea.

meals.breakfast: Luxury Vietnamese breakfast at the resort — congee (cháo), fresh tropical fruits, Vietnamese iced coffee (cà phê sữa đá), and steamed bánh cuốn.
meals.lunch: Enjoy dishes prepared during the cooking class in a private dining setting.
meals.dinner: Fine dining at a nearby acclaimed restaurant — tasting menu featuring 7-course Vietnamese fusion cuisine with wine pairing.

day_by_day.notes: Book the cooking class in advance through the resort concierge. Bring comfortable clothing for the village walk. Apply sunscreen — coastal April sun can be intense.

day_by_day.morning: Private speedboat excursion to a nearby island or bay (resort concierge to arrange). Snorkeling in crystal-clear waters with premium gear provided. Explore hidden sea caves and coral reefs with a certified marine guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to resort for a traditional Vietnamese spa treatment — the 'Bamboo Harmony' full-body massage using locally sourced herbs and warm bamboo rods. Followed by a dip in the infinity pool.
day_by_day.evening: Private beachfront dinner under the stars — a specially curated menu of grilled lobster, crab, and sea bass with Vietnamese herbs, served directly on the sand with candlelit ambiance and live acoustic music.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet with an emphasis on local specialties — bánh mì station, pho bar, tropical smoothie bowls.
meals.lunch: Fresh seafood BBQ on the island/boat — grilled fish, squid, and vegetables with nuoc cham dipping sauce.
meals.dinner: Exclusive private beachfront seafood dinner arranged by resort — premium lobster, crab, and local catch with Vietnamese herb sauces.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm boat excursion weather conditions the evening before. Bring waterproof sunscreen, a hat, and a light cover-up. Spa booking recommended 24 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Private car transfer to a nearby UNESCO World Heritage Site or historic old town (e.g., Hội An or Huế depending on resort location). Morning guided walking tour of ancient temples, imperial citadels, or lantern-lit old quarters with a private cultural historian.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the local market with your guide — taste street food delicacies such as cao lầu (Hội An noodles), bánh xèo (sizzling crepes), and fresh coconut ice cream. Visit artisan workshops for silk weaving, lantern making, or lacquerware.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset river cruise on a traditional wooden boat with champagne and canapés. Watch lanterns float on the river as locals celebrate. Return to resort by private car.

meals.breakfast: In-room premium breakfast service — eggs Benedict with Vietnamese pork belly, fresh juices, and Vietnamese drip coffee.
meals.lunch: Street food tour lunch — curated tasting of 5-6 local street dishes at top-rated local stalls with your guide.
meals.dinner: Dinner at an award-winning restaurant in the heritage town — signature dishes include white rose dumplings, braised pork belly with rice, and mango sticky rice dessert.

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable walking shoes for cobblestone streets. Dress modestly for temple visits (shoulders and knees covered). Carry small VND cash for street food stalls.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning private motorbike tour through rural Vietnamese countryside — ride through rice paddies, lotus ponds, and local villages with a professional guide. Stop at a traditional family home for tea and conversation.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a premium local coffee plantation or tea estate. Learn about Vietnam's world-renowned coffee culture, participate in a cupping session, and enjoy freshly brewed specialty Vietnamese coffee. Purchase artisan blends to bring home.
day_by_day.evening: Return to resort. Attend a private traditional Vietnamese music performance (đàn tranh and đàn bầu instruments) arranged by the resort in an intimate garden setting, followed by cocktails.

meals.breakfast: Grab-and-go Vietnamese street breakfast during the motorbike tour — xôi (sticky rice), bánh mì with pâté, and fresh sugarcane juice.
meals.lunch: Farm-to-table lunch at the coffee/tea estate — Vietnamese countryside cuisine including clay pot fish, morning glory stir-fry, and fresh spring rolls.
meals.dinner: Resort fine dining — Vietnamese royal cuisine tasting menu inspired by Nguyễn Dynasty recipes, with premium wine pairing.

day_by_day.notes: Motorbike tour requires signing a waiver. Helmets provided. Inform guide of any dietary restrictions for farm lunch. Bring a light jacket for the evening performance.

day_by_day.morning: Guided kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding along the coastline with a certified instructor. Explore mangrove forests, hidden lagoons, and sea caves accessible only by water. Premium equipment and safety gear provided.
day_by_day.afternoon: Luxury resort afternoon — enjoy the private beach cabana, order poolside cocktails and Vietnamese tapas, and indulge in a premium facial treatment at the resort spa using local ingredients like green tea, turmeric, and rice bran.
day_by_day.evening: Street food immersion evening — private tuk-tuk or cyclo tour through the nearest town's most vibrant street food district. Visit 4-5 curated local stalls for bún bò Huế, nem nướng (grilled pork skewers), and chè desserts.

meals.breakfast: Resort restaurant — full Vietnamese breakfast with congee, dim sum-style dumplings, tropical fruits, and Vietnamese egg coffee.
meals.lunch: Poolside premium lunch — grilled seafood platter, Vietnamese rice paper rolls, fresh coconut, and mango salad.
meals.dinner: Street food tour dinner — authentic local dishes across multiple stalls, curated for quality and hygiene by your private guide.

day_by_day.notes: Street food tour is a highlight — embrace the experience fully. The resort concierge can arrange a private guide who speaks English fluently. Bring hand sanitizer and try everything!

day_by_day.morning: Full-day private excursion to a nearby national park or nature reserve. Morning guided jungle trek with a naturalist — spot exotic birds, butterflies, and tropical flora. Visit a local ethnic minority village to learn about indigenous traditions and handicrafts.
day_by_day.afternoon: Picnic lunch in a scenic jungle clearing or waterfall setting. Continue exploring the park — optional bamboo rafting or zip-lining through the forest canopy for adventure enthusiasts.
day_by_day.evening: Return to resort. Enjoy a private rooftop dinner with panoramic views — chef's special Vietnamese-French fusion tasting menu with sommelier-selected wine pairing.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast before departure — Vietnamese noodle soup, fresh fruit, and strong Vietnamese coffee.
meals.lunch: Gourmet picnic basket prepared by the resort chef — Vietnamese sandwiches, fruit, artisan cheeses, and sparkling water served in a scenic natural setting.
meals.dinner: Private rooftop dining at the resort — Vietnamese-French fusion tasting menu featuring duck confit with lemongrass jus, prawn bisque, and coconut panna cotta.

day_by_day.notes: Wear long sleeves and insect repellent for the jungle trek. Sturdy closed-toe shoes required. Inform the resort of any allergies for the picnic basket preparation.

day_by_day.morning: Private cultural immersion workshop — choose from traditional Vietnamese calligraphy, silk painting, or pottery at a local artisan studio. Work alongside a master craftsperson to create your own keepsake piece.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a premium local market with a personal shopping guide — explore tailored ao dài (traditional Vietnamese dress), hand-embroidered linens, lacquerware, and custom jewelry. Option to have bespoke clothing tailored within 24 hours.
day_by_day.evening: Exclusive dinner at a private chef's table experience — dine in the kitchen of a celebrated local chef for a 9-course progressive Vietnamese tasting menu with narrative storytelling about each dish's cultural heritage.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast service — French press Vietnamese coffee, eggs your way, fresh tropical fruit platter, and warm bánh mì.
meals.lunch: Lunch at a highly-rated local restaurant near the market — bún thịt nướng (grilled pork vermicelli), fresh coconut water, and mango pudding.
meals.dinner: Private chef's table — 9-course Vietnamese tasting menu with wine pairing. Reservation required well in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Tailoring turnaround is typically 24-48 hours — order on Day 8 for pickup on Day 9 or 10. Chef's table is an exclusive experience — confirm booking through resort concierge at least 3 days prior.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise helicopter or seaplane tour over the coastline and surrounding landscape (subject to availability and weather) — aerial views of rice paddies, bays, islands, and fishing villages. A truly premium and unforgettable experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to resort for a leisurely final full afternoon. Enjoy a couples or solo premium spa journey — 3-hour Vietnamese wellness ritual including herbal steam bath, body scrub with coffee and coconut, and a 90-minute deep tissue massage.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the resort's most prestigious restaurant — order à la carte from the premium menu featuring Vietnamese imperial dishes, fresh seafood, and decadent desserts. Toast the journey with a bottle of premium champagne.

meals.breakfast: Light resort breakfast before the helicopter/seaplane tour — fresh juices, pastries, and Vietnamese iced coffee.
meals.lunch: Post-spa light lunch at the resort pool bar — Vietnamese noodle salad, fresh spring rolls, and coconut smoothie.
meals.dinner: Grand farewell dinner at the resort's flagship restaurant — imperial Vietnamese cuisine with champagne toast and a personalized dessert from the pastry chef.

day_by_day.notes: Helicopter/seaplane tour must be booked at least 3-4 days in advance through the resort. Weather-dependent — have a backup activity planned. Spa journey is the perfect wind-down before departure.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise walk along the private beach — collect memories, take photos, and enjoy a quiet moment by the sea. Attend a final Vietnamese coffee ritual session at the resort's café — learn the art of cà phê trứng (egg coffee) and cà phê sữa đá.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check-out formalities with resort concierge. Collect any tailored clothing or purchased artisan pieces. Private luxury car transfer to the airport. Enjoy a premium airport lounge experience before departure.
day_by_day.evening: Departure — carry the flavors, sights, and memories of Vietnam with you. In-flight or airport farewell dinner at a premium lounge or restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — full spread of Vietnamese favorites: pho, bánh mì, tropical fruits, egg coffee, and fresh juices.
meals.lunch: Light farewell lunch at the resort before checkout — Vietnamese rice paper rolls, papaya salad, and sparkling water.
meals.dinner: Premium airport lounge dining or in-flight business/first class meal service.

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before departure for airport transfer and check-in. Ask the resort to prepare a farewell gift bag with local teas, coffees, or artisan snacks. Request a late checkout if your flight allows — typically available for premium guests.
